            "start": 1027,
            "text": "Die Initiative fordert, dass die monatliche Rente nicht nur 12 Mal, sondern 13 Mal pro Jahr ausbezahlt wird.",
            "text_sha256": "d34cf1a2af61f1828459fb696b1a808b5ccd237470082a64c77d2b0061f96b66"
          },
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 4,

            "pdf_page": 4,
            "span_id": "sp-df2d2f588ab3cde53e29",
            "start": 661,
            "text": "Zu den 12 Monatsrenten käme jedes Jahr eine 13. Rente dazu.",
            "text_sha256": "bc048891774a398e49844ccdef2bd02928c1dbb850e6c53f8c6627e794874bc8"
          }
        ],
        "id": "P01",
        "kind": "DIRECT_PROVISION",
        "origin": "REVIEWED_APERTUS_ASSISTED_CASE",
        "review_status": "HUMAN_REVIEWED_STATEMENT",
        "statement": "The initiative would give AHV old-age pension recipients an annual supplement equal to one twelfth of their annual pension—described in the booklet as a 13th pension payment.",
        "title": "What changes"
      },
      {
        "citations": [
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 2,
            "end": 672,
            "identity_sha256": "f2d89f437b4fb79c22167caf74655564fe87a459f72e4f1995d6da1fc719e2f0",
            "page_url": "https://www.bk.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/In9i5Kp4p64r/2024-03-03_erlaeuterungen_des_bundesrates.pdf#page=11",
            "pdf_page": 11,
            "span_id": "sp-f2d89f437b4fb79c2216",
            "start": 566,
            "text": "Die 13. AHV-Rente würde bei der Einführung voraussichtlich etwa 4,1 Milliarden Franken zusätzlich kosten.2",
            "text_sha256": "c3c9beecb067abe982749da32b306137228037e87db62aae3573bf2a768f55c3"
          },
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 4,
            "end": 1179,
            "identity_sha256": "9acf2ebeaa24c5dacbab8d3529791492147871467515527cac8b08cb2bf0c802",
            "page_url": "https://www.bk.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/In9i5Kp4p64r/2024-03-03_erlaeuterungen_des_bundesrates.pdf#page=4",
            "pdf_page": 4,
            "span_id": "sp-9acf2ebeaa24c5dacbab",
            "start": 986,
            "text": "Durch diese Erhöhung würden die Kosten für die 13. AHV- Rente bei der Einführung voraussichtlich etwa 4,1 Milliarden Franken betragen; davon müsste der Bund rund 800 Millionen Franken bezahlen.",
            "text_sha256": "b4d63038683014b09f8677ac2f3caff1541db22bd0ae8be20ae7067717f04c09"
          }
        ],
        "id": "P02",
        "kind": "COST_PROJECTION",
        "origin": "REVIEWED_APERTUS_ASSISTED_CASE",
        "review_status": "HUMAN_REVIEWED_STATEMENT",
        "statement": "According to the government’s pre-vote estimate, introducing the 13th AHV old-age pension would add approximately CHF 4.1 billion a year to AHV spending.",
        "title": "Cost at introduction"
      },
      {
        "citations": [
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 2,
            "end": 965,
            "identity_sha256": "2275e83fa97bea1e8eee821b3a0e4f4008d67601ccb4368b8d84f19aceb1be19",
            "page_url": "https://www.bk.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/In9i5Kp4p64r/2024-03-03_erlaeuterungen_des_bundesrates.pdf#page=11",
            "pdf_page": 11,
            "span_id": "sp-2275e83fa97bea1e8eee",
            "start": 869,
            "text": "Fünf Jahre nach Einführung würden die Kosten voraussichtlich rund 5 Milliarden Franken betragen.",
            "text_sha256": "67afcf5a0024f29bfbc7a58c2a6bd3b21a5da54e3158a58369cd5de2c6360951"
          }

        "id": "P03",
        "kind": "COST_PROJECTION",
        "origin": "REVIEWED_REFERENCE_CONTEXT",
        "review_status": "HUMAN_REVIEWED_STATEMENT",
        "statement": "According to the government’s pre-vote projection, the additional annual cost of the 13th AHV old-age pension would reach around CHF 5 billion five years after introduction.",
        "title": "Cost after five years"
      },
      {
        "citations": [
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 3,
            "end": 1103,
            "identity_sha256": "bf43dc012a35bce8bbd2949ff64501700c1c7d94c66b7998e2e433e7a0099bff",

            "pdf_page": 11,
            "span_id": "sp-bf43dc012a35bce8bbd2",
            "start": 985,
            "text": "Die Initiative macht keine Angaben dazu, wie die zusätzlichen Ausgaben für die 13. AHV-Rente finanziert werden sollen.",

          },
          {
            "actor": "GOVERNMENT",
            "block_number": 4,
            "end": 1284,
            "identity_sha256": "3c5b9fb6a0283b70075b833cbecb4244236cc5903add0e4bcf6f06d540489314",
            "page_url": "https://www.bk.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/In9i5Kp4p64r/2024-03-03_erlaeuterungen_des_bundesrates.pdf#page=4",
            "pdf_page": 4,
            "span_id": "sp-3c5b9fb6a0283b70075b",
            "start": 1230,
            "text": "Die Initiative lässt die Frage der Finanzierung offen.",
            "text_sha256": "b2e55fbbff378f77e3217bba32ec1d2117f02dc71edec7831b1d271135e03689"
          }

            "pdf_page": 16,
            "span_id": "sp-92f4ef4f294b8ca65441",
            "start": 1705,
